title: Rotating Strength-Anchor Full Body Program.
author: Bhavin S.
desc:
This style of training is called a Heavy-Light Daily Undulating Periodization (DUP) Full-Body Split.

Here is the breakdown of why it gets that name:

Daily Undulating Periodization (DUP): "Undulating" means the intensity waves up and down. Instead of changing your reps every few weeks, you change your focus daily—alternating which muscle groups get heavy strength work and which get lighter hypertrophy work.

Heavy-Light / Strength-Hypertrophy Split: Every single workout features a "Heavy" core (your barbell strength compounds) followed by a "Light/Medium" volume core (your dumbbell and cable hypertrophy supersets).

Full-Body High Frequency: You are training your entire body during every single session, hitting every major muscle group 3 times a week.
